name: DiffusionGemma structured decisions
description: Experimental vLLM-backed DiffusionGemma structured decisions through the Jev API.
limitations: Source-only container integration; build containers/djev/Dockerfile before launch.
Jev structured decisions and schema-based chat only; no Responses or Anthropic endpoints.
Loopback-only gateway; confidence and standard errors are not calibrated accuracy.
Uses the pinned vLLM runtime, not native SparkLab diffusion kernels.
